reason: Folder intake and host dedupe treat Stash being unreachable, a dropped connection or a 502/503/504 as stash_unavailable: the scheduled stash-intake-folders and stash-dedupe-host commands report a skipped run and keep their journals for the next run instead of failing. Other HTTP errors keep their rejection codes. Gallery workers, queued work, checkpoints and capture semantics are unchanged; execution v10 and capture v1 are unchanged.
